Name: Cozier Default Farmhouses
Author: DexModsOfficial
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SvYBSIK.png[/img][/center]
[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]ABOUT[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[font=Verdana][size=3]Adds a tiny kitchen to the default farmhouse and adds a bathroom with the first and second house upgrades. The default and first house layouts have been altered to be cozier. This works with or without a spouse.[/size][/font]

[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]new tiny kitchen area for first default farmhouse[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]first default farmhouse has fully functional mini-fridge and microwave (works as oven)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]adjusted kitchen placement for first upgrade[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]adjusted layout for second upgrade's corner room (corner room ONLY)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]multiplayer cabins covered, default and first upgrades[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]first and second upgrades (corner room) include a bathroom with a functioning sauna/bath and swimsuit change[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]bathroom allows for wallpaper and flooring customization and some decor can be added to it (like windows)[/size][/font]
[/list]
